sets.relationshipLabel: raw material becomes worked material through processing
sets.explanation: Hide is tanned into leather just as flax is spun into thread — each pair names a raw material and the finished good it becomes.

sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A saddler works leather with an awl, while a tanner works hides with a fleshing knife — each craftsman paired with the tool that defines their trade.

sets.relationshipLabel: leather cover and the structure it hides beneath it
sets.explanation: A skirt conceals the saddle tree and a flap conceals the billet strap — each visible leather panel hides a working part underneath it.

sets.relationshipLabel: opening and closing stage of a process
sets.explanation: Soaking begins the tanning process just as finishing ends it, and breaking-in begins a working life just as retiring ends it — each pair marks the first and last stage of a very different span.
